world.description: a pencil logistics and supply network

world.label: Pencil Supply Network
world.summary: A network of specialists moves wood and graphite through pencil production and on to shops with recurring customer orders.

actions.description: Harvest timber and place it in a timber yard.
Mine graphite ore and place it in an ore store.
Use timber from a yard to make slats for a slat store.
Refine graphite ore for a graphite store.
Use graphite from a store to make pencil cores for a core store.
Use slats and cores from stores to assemble pencils for a warehouse.
Carry pencils from a warehouse to a shop.
Place a pencil order with a shop.

mechanics.rationale: A forester harvests the requested quantity into a timber yard; the action does not consume a represented resource.

checks.label: the forester is assigned to harvesting timber
the timber yard is in the same network
the harvested amount is positive

limits: Only a forester assigned to harvesting timber can harvest.
This action adds timber to the chosen stockroom; it does not verify that the stockroom is specifically a timber yard.
tests: A positive quantity adds that amount to the chosen stockroom's timber.
A zero or negative quantity is refused.
A worker with a different specialty is refused.
semantic_bindings: quantity is the amount of timber harvested
to is the receiving timber yard

mechanics.rationale: A graphite miner adds the requested quantity of ore to the receiving store.

checks.label: the miner is assigned to mining graphite ore
the ore store is in the same network
the mined amount is positive

limits: Only a miner assigned to mining graphite ore can mine.
The chosen receiving stockroom is not otherwise verified as an ore store.
tests: A positive quantity adds that amount of graphite ore to the receiving stockroom.
A zero or negative quantity is refused.
A worker with a different specialty is refused.
semantic_bindings: quantity is the amount of graphite ore mined
to is the receiving ore store

mechanics.rationale: Sawing converts timber in the source yard into the same quantity of slats in the destination store.

checks.label: the miller is assigned to sawing timber into slats
the timber yard has enough timber
the amount to saw is positive
the timber yard and slat store are in the same network

limits: The conversion is one unit of timber to one unit of slats.
The action does not verify that the source and destination are specifically a timber yard and slat store.
tests: With sufficient timber, the requested quantity is removed and added as slats.
Insufficient timber, a nonpositive quantity, or different locations causes refusal.
A worker with a different specialty is refused.
semantic_bindings: quantity is the number of timber units converted

mechanics.rationale: Refining consumes graphite ore and adds the same quantity of graphite to the destination store.

checks.label: the refiner is assigned to refining graphite
the ore store has enough graphite ore
the amount to refine is positive
the ore store and graphite store are in the same network

limits: The conversion is one unit of graphite ore to one unit of graphite.
The action does not verify that the stores are specifically an ore store and graphite store.
tests: With sufficient ore, the requested quantity is consumed and added as graphite.
Insufficient ore, a nonpositive quantity, or different locations causes refusal.
A worker with a different specialty is refused.
semantic_bindings: quantity is the number of ore units refined

mechanics.rationale: Making cores consumes graphite and adds the same quantity of cores to the destination store.

checks.label: the core maker is assigned to making pencil cores
the graphite store has enough graphite
the amount to make is positive
the graphite store and core store are in the same network

limits: The conversion is one unit of graphite to one pencil core.
The action does not verify that the stores are specifically a graphite store and core store.
tests: With sufficient graphite, the requested quantity is consumed and added as cores.
Insufficient graphite, a nonpositive quantity, or different locations causes refusal.
A worker with a different specialty is refused.
semantic_bindings: quantity is the number of cores made

mechanics.rationale: Assembly consumes one slat and one core per pencil and adds the requested pencils to the warehouse.

checks.label: the assembler is assigned to assembling pencils
the slat store has enough slats
the core store has enough cores
the assembly amount is positive
the stores and warehouse are in the same network
the core store and warehouse are in the same network

limits: Assembly uses one slat and one core per pencil.
The action does not verify the exact types of the chosen stockrooms.
tests: With enough slats and cores, assembly consumes each quantity and adds that many pencils.
Insufficient inputs, a nonpositive quantity, or a location mismatch causes refusal.
A worker with a different specialty is refused.
semantic_bindings: quantity is the number of pencils assembled

mechanics.rationale: Carrying pencils transfers the requested quantity from a warehouse to a shop.

checks.label: the carrier is assigned to carrying pencils to shops
the warehouse has enough pencils
the amount to carry is positive
the warehouse and shop are in the same network

limits: Only a shop-category destination can receive the transfer.
The action does not change waiting orders or verify a particular warehouse.
tests: With enough warehouse stock, the requested pencils are transferred to the shop.
Insufficient stock, a nonpositive quantity, or different locations causes refusal.
A worker with a different specialty is refused.
semantic_bindings: quantity is the number of pencils delivered

mechanics.rationale: A customer places a positive-quantity order by adding it to a shop's waiting orders.

checks.label: the shop is in the same network
the order quantity is positive

limits: Only a customer can place an order through this action.
Placing an order changes the waiting-order count; it does not consume pencils or automatically serve the order.
tests: A positive quantity increases the shop's waiting orders by that quantity.
A zero or negative quantity is refused.
An entity that is not a customer cannot use this action.
semantic_bindings: quantity is the number of pencils ordered

processes.rationale: Recurring regrowth replenishes the represented timber supply so harvesting can continue.

checks.label: this stockroom is the timber yard

processes.rationale: Recurring ore renewal replenishes the represented graphite ore supply so mining can continue.

checks.label: this stockroom holds graphite ore

processes.rationale: New customer demand arrives at the represented pencil shop each round.

readout.title: How coordination slowed (the four mechanisms of the Waltzman paper)
readout.summary: The workers repeatedly gathered timber and graphite, made pencil parts, assembled pencils, and delivered them to the shop. Orders kept accumulating faster than deliveries, with no recorded coordination dispute or decision process slowing the work.

mechanisms.name: Local concerns through separate channels
mechanisms.missing_reason: No concerns, communication routes, or decision makers are recorded.

mechanisms.name: Slowed meetings
mechanisms.missing_reason: No meetings, reviews, or decision deadlines are recorded.

mechanisms.name: Reopened settled issues
mechanisms.missing_reason: No settled decision or issue is recorded as being undone or reopened.

mechanisms.name: Conditional support delaying deployment
mechanisms.missing_reason: No conditional support or deployment decision is recorded.
